description:
## [1.8.0](https://github.com/rimixyz/morphe-patches/compare/v1.7.0...v1.8.0) (2026-11-25)

### ✨ New Features

* add Auto Clicker support with Pro unlock and ad/tracking patches ([a530fcb](https://github.com/rimixyz/morphe-patches/commit/a530fcbc7a69eac408de20a6b2ad4a13ad008426))
* add Notisave support with premium unlock, ad-free mode and Portuguese translation ([e2e5fe6](https://github.com/rimixyz/morphe-patches/commit/e2e5fe6f84ec94e6ccd788535c8cdf33a7bf9321))
* add XRecorder support with Pro unlock, ad and tracking patches ([6c89968](https://github.com/rimixyz/morphe-patches/commit/6c899680bb2192cefa27251611543a582db03ce5))

### 🔧 Improvements

* enable validated XRecorder patches by default ([7ca3928](https://github.com/rimixyz/morphe-patches/commit/7ca3928f0cb4384e21637b8fd996cb3fb6ab4dd9))

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* document Android 17 accessibility requirement in patch descriptions ([67d628c](https://github.com/rimixyz/morphe-patches/commit/67d628c1cef304bef99e4fe12bf7de76b89caa25))

patches.name: Remove Yodo1 ads and analytics
patches.description: Suppresses Yodo1 MAS banners, interstitials, rewarded videos, app-open ads (including SDK init preloads), and stops the bundled ThinkingData analytics tracker (c1.yodo1.com). Rewarded flows still grant their in-game reward.

patches.name: Unlock Pro
patches.description: Grants the Pro license locally by injecting a synthetic purchase into the Distriqt billing events. Unlocks the editor and the full career content.

patches.name: Bypass PairIP protection
patches.description: Restores the obfuscated runtime values and disables the PairIP virtual machine.

patches.name: Disable analytics and tracking
patches.description: Disables Firebase Analytics and Crashlytics collection and removes advertising ID permissions.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Grants the local premium state the app reads for its paid features.

patches.name: Convert IAP items to Star Bux
patches.description: Converts real-money boots, Super NRG drinks, and Pro/Expert agents and trainers into Star Bux purchases in both modern and classic UI, and replaces the dead Buy Bux redirect with an in-game insufficient-funds banner.

patches.name: Disable Google Play Games
patches.description: Disables broken Google Play Games auto-sign-in on re-signed APKs and hides the dead Play Games button on the Career screen (modern and classic UI).

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Blocks AdMob and DT Exchange/Fyber interstitial ads, removes the built-in promo interstitial, and hides the promotional "Games we like" button while keeping opt-in rewarded videos.

patches.name: Disable analytics and tracking
patches.description: Disables Firebase Analytics, Flurry analytics and startup measurement, and removes Advertising ID permissions.

patches.name: Disable remote config and cloud overrides
patches.description: Freezes the in-game Cloud/DLC/Cohort override system so remote updates and cached DLC files can never overwrite local patched assets or TweakValues, and speeds up startup.

patches.name: Disable retention notifications
patches.description: Prevents the game from scheduling local "come back and play" reminder notifications whenever it goes to the background.

patches.name: Enhanced replays and MP4/GIF export
patches.description: Adds a Replay Studio button during goal replays to customize playback speed, loop, slow-mo overlays, all-chance replays, and export clean HUD-free MP4 videos or animated GIFs.

patches.name: Fix text input backspace
patches.description: Fixes backspace when typing names in the game by using the in-game keyboard, which has a working delete button.

patches.name: Retro season selector
patches.description: Prompts to choose a historical club database (2011–2026) bundled in the APK whenever you start a new career. Existing careers are unaffected.

patches.name: Save backup and restore
patches.description: Adds a Backup button to the Career screen (modern and classic UI) to export and restore your full save via the system file picker, with automatic rollback protection.

patches.name: Unlock Pro features
patches.description: Unlocks the Pro license, ad removal, pitches/weather and special balls by setting the local license flags the game checks.

patches.name: Disable ads and tracking
patches.description: Blocks ads, disables Blytics, Singular, Firebase Analytics and AppMetrica activation, and prevents Advertising ID lookups.

patches.name: Translate to Brazilian Portuguese
patches.description: Adds Brazilian Portuguese translations for Notisave when the device language is Portuguese (Brazil).

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Grants the local premium state the app reads for its paywall, VIP support, settings locks and ad-free UI.

patches.name: Disable ads and tracking
patches.description: Blocks AdMob banner/interstitial ads and SDK initialization, disables Firebase Analytics and Crashlytics events, and removes advertising ID permissions. REQUIRES Accessibility: on Android 17, disable Advanced Protection or allow restricted settings (Apps > Auto Clicker > menu > Allow restricted settings), then enable the Auto Clicker service.

patches.name: Unlock Pro
patches.description: Grants the local ad-free/premium state without a purchase. REQUIRES Accessibility: on Android 17, disable Advanced Protection or allow restricted settings (Apps > Auto Clicker > menu > Allow restricted settings), then enable the Auto Clicker service.

patches.name: Disable PairIP license check
patches.description: Neutralizes the PairIP license check so the re-signed APK can start, without removing its components.

patches.name: Disable all ads
patches.description: Blocks all ad formats (banner, native, interstitial and rewarded), stops Mobile Ads/mediation SDK initialization, and skips UMP ad consent prompts.

patches.name: Disable analytics and tracking
patches.description: Disables Firebase Analytics, AppsFlyer attribution, Sentry diagnostics, internal analytics tracking, and removes Advertising ID permissions.

patches.name: Local backup and restore
patches.description: Adds a Local Backup & Restore item to Settings to export/restore local .zip backups (with automatic rollback) and import official MyTherapy Archive CSV history.

patches.name: Unlock Plus benefits
patches.description: Grants the local Plus state the app reads for ad-free access, extra calendar days and the PDF entry point.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Blocks app-open ad load/show in XRecorder. SDK init is kept because the splash depends on it; ad-free comes from Unlock Pro's IProChecker. Server-side ad decisions are not affected. Known issue: the Edit tab closes in tests while loading the native video engine; core screen recording works with Pro unlocked.

patches.name: Disable analytics and tracking
patches.description: Disables Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics and ad ID permissions in XRecorder. Does not change any server-side feature or account state. Known issue: the Edit tab closes in tests while loading the native video engine; core screen recording works with Pro unlocked.

patches.name: Disable remote config
patches.description: Freezes Firebase Remote Config overrides (AdCfg25, ServerDomain) in XRecorder. Server-side features and A/B flags are NOT emulated. Known issue: the Edit tab closes in tests while loading the native video engine; core screen recording works with Pro unlocked.

patches.name: Unlock Pro
patches.description: Unlocks the local Pro state of XRecorder (paywall, locks, ad-free). LOCAL ONLY: server-side AI, credits/quotas and subscription token validation are NOT unlocked. Known issue: the Edit tab closes in tests while loading the native video engine; core screen recording works with Pro unlocked.

patches.name: Disable ads and tracking
patches.description: Blocks all AdMob and Flutter Google Mobile Ads formats, hides the 'Deals' tab and campaign promos, disables Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, and Facebook SDK auto-tracking, and removes Advertising ID permissions.

patches.name: Fix Firebase after re-signing
patches.description: Restores the original certificate SHA-1 so Firebase Auth (Google login) and push notifications keep working after the APK is re-signed.
